method: Read-only replay of saved candidates through existing compatibility gate; no model calls, output edits, or gold-assisted repair.

confirmed_mechanism: Unscored nausea candidates have null severity_context and time_text="today up to now". The fallback gate rejects the word now; scored worst_today_so_far candidates pass an earlier branch. Only eligible records enter daily_groups, so the pair remains separate. Exact-object deduplication cannot remove unequal candidates.
interpretation: The model caused duplicate candidates. The conservative gate lets them persist and does not distinguish this cumulative phrase from current-only timing. This is a deterministic handling gap; do not assume every same-day pair is interchangeable.
recommended_next_step: Define a narrow duplicate/subsumption policy using same report, symptom, assertion, compatible context, supported non-null values and source evidence; preserve all raw candidates. Recognize explicit cumulative-today phrases without treating right now/current/morning statements as daily summaries. Flag uncertain cases instead of silently dropping them. Keep raw extraction and normalized metrics separate.
required_negative_controls: Current nausea now versus a daily worst rating
Different event dates or clock times
Identical quotes with distinct current-versus-daily assertions
